# Mike Vibert

Mike Vibert is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 1996.

Mike Vibert has participated in 2 elections since 2002:

- [**2002 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mike-vibert#e2)

  Elected as Senator with 50.2% of the ballot.
- [**2008 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mike-vibert#e10)

  Not elected.

  - [2008 Full Manifesto](http://jerseyelections.info/senators/mike-vibert.html)

* * *

* * *
